description:
## Description

"This is Havez'Ωs first speaker system developed by Dudley Harwood, who was chief engineer at BBC Research for 30years, taking advantage of the know-how gained through designing famous monitor speakers.Based on a study conducted by the BBC, it was concluded that two way is sufficient to cover the audio band, so a two way configuration was adopted.A 20cm cone type woofer is used for the low range.The diaphragm is made of polypropylene cone, which has superior characteristics compared to paper cone and polystyrene cone.A soft dome type tweeter of Sonoh DACS HD-12and D25-8type is adopted for the high range.The network circuit is thoroughly examined from the parts to the circuit structure, and uses auto TRANSFORMERS with laminated core and solid deelectret condenser.High-quality birch plywood is used as the enclosure material, and in order to minimize resonance, two types of sound absorbing materials with different sound absorption coefficients are used to create an enclosure with a natural sound.The optimum listening position is set, and it is recommended to use it 1m away from the wall and at least 25cm away from the floor in a general room.The speaker stand is sold separately and is made of natural solid teak."

name: SUPERHL5
description:
## Description

"This is a speaker system developed with Havez technology as a speaker that inherits the design philosophy of HL5.For the low range, we have adopted a 20cm cone type woofer using RADIAL cone which was completed after repeated trial and error through technical exchange with material manufacturers and university laboratories since the 90'Ωs.This unit adjusts the amount of aluminum while taking advantage of the advantages of polypropylene. Moreover, by changing the blend from the center to the periphery of the diaphragm, various problems that occur on the surface of the cone in the middle and low band and middle and high band are reduced.Harvez has introduced high-precision molding equipment for the production of this cone and is focusing on the development of driver units with physical properties superior to those of ordinary vacuum molded polypropylene cones. Has achieved units with excellent characteristics.A 2.5cm diameter aluminum hard dome type tweeter is used for the high frequency band.Ferrofluid cooling treatment is applied so that sound does not collapse even at high temperature. It is a custom-made model by SEAS based on Havez specifications in order to support a wide range of digital sources.The Super HL5is equipped with a super tweeter for the first time in the history of the HL family.The unit is a 2cm hard dome type super tweeter with titanium diaphragm, and the resolution and air feeling are improved by receiving the high frequency of 10khz or more.In addition, a neodymium magnet is used for the magnetic circuit.The crossover network is designed by Alan Shaw with a computer grade board and other carefully selected minimal parts, and the circuit is mounted after computer testing and listening.The speaker terminal supports a banana plug for bi-wiring connection.In order to realize the ""Havez sound"", the enclosure design employs the Super Tuned Structure technology, which eliminates unwanted resonance in the mid-frequency range from the material by tuning the mass and compliance of the material, and tunes the material by computer analysis so that very thin material can respond quickly to the sound energy.In addition, by using high hardness and thin materials with different resonance and stiffness, and by using a unique approach to adjust the overall tone while damping with a tar-based material with multiple layers of these materials, unnecessary resonance is damped at high speed by the physical properties of the material itself and its combination, rather than being suppressed by weight and rigidity.The edge of the front baffle is rounded to reduce acoustic diffraction, and the front baffle groove is embedded with a Jersey grill to enhance enclosure integration and reduce the impact on sound quality with SuperGrille.It is finished with cherry finish.A special speaker stand is sold separately."

description:
## Description

"This is the first speaker system that Alan Shaw developed after taking over the Havez Company from Dudley Harwood.A 20cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.New material TPX is used for the cone. This material, which was also used for HL TypeIV, was a lightweight thermoplastic material with excellent self-damping, but it had the drawback of being difficult to process. At Harvey, this was overcome by using it for the diaphragm.A long protruding acoustic lens is attached to the center of the unit.A 2.5cm hard ohm type tweeter is installed in the high range.Aluminum diaphragm is used for the diaphragm.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.A bass reflex port was designed and adopted using computer analysis.The exterior is finished with natural teak material.The speaker jacks are bi-wired.In the process of assembling the HL Compact, such as the right and left units, woofer and tweeter, the characteristics of each unit were checked and shipped as a pair with the best matching unit.There was a special stand sold separately."

name: HLCOMPACT7
description:
## Description

"This is a speaker system that has been thoroughly reviewed in pursuit of realism and clarity by further polishing the beautiful sound unique to Havez.A 20cm cone woofer with a newly designed original diaphragm is mounted in the low range.This cone uses a diaphragm manufacturing method that blends three types of polymers and arranges them from the center to the periphery, solving the problem of different cone surfaces near the center and at the periphery.In addition, the voice coil has a unique structure with air permeability in mind to stabilize temperature characteristics over a long period of time.A 2.5cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit is a hard dome type evaporated on a unique T-yoke, and uses ferrofluid cooling to facilitate heat diffusion at high temperature of voice coil by applying magnetic oil.A unique Super Tuned Structure (STS) is introduced in the enclosure design. By using a special sandwich structure in which multiple materials with different resonance and stiffness are layered between hard MDF materials, unwanted vibrations are damped while making use of the sound by combining with the physical properties of the material itself rather than weight or rigidity.The bass reflex port of the enclosure is made into a square shape based on repeated trial listening, and important parts inside the enclosure are dumped with tar material.The Frameless Frame method is used for the net grill. A different jersey material is used for the net grill. The frame of the grill is fitted into the groove of the baffle to improve the integration with the enclosure, thereby minimizing the influence on the high frequency range.There was a special stand sold separately."

name: HLCOMPACT7ES-2
description:
## Description

"While inheriting the musicality of HL Compact and HL Compact 7, this speaker system was refined by technical exchange with engineers of BBC.A 20cm cone type speaker unit with a RADIAL cone is used for the low range.While taking advantage of the advantages of polypropylene, this cone optimizes the amount of aluminum, and by changing the amount of blend from the center of the diaphragm to the periphery, it reduces various problems that occur on the cone surface in the middle and low band and middle and high band.In addition, in the HL Compact 7ES-2, in partnership with BBS engineers, the RADIAL cone has been further polished to improve reproducibility in a compact enclosure.A 2.5cm hard dome type tweeter is used for the high range.The diaphragm is made of aluminum and has a high input resistant design.The network uses carefully selected top-quality parts, including computer-grade fiberglass substrates.The assembled circuit is tested one by one by computer, and after the matching is made, the trial listening is repeated and mounted.The speaker terminal can be bi-wired and can be connected to a banana plug.The enclosure is designed in accordance with the BBC tradition with removable front and rear baffles to create a lossy coupling structure.In addition, by creating a sandwich structure in which multiple materials with different resonance and stiffness are layered between hard materials, resonance is damped not by weight or rigidity but by the physical properties of the material itself and its combination.In addition, we have adopted the Super Tuned Structure, which is tuned based on computer analysis so that thin materials can react quickly to the sound energy rather than making the structure thick and difficult to control. By tuning the mass and compliance of the materials, we have succeeded in eliminating unwanted resonance in the especially important mid-range from the materials.The edges of the front baffle have been rounded to reduce acoustic diffraction at the edges.The jersey grill is installed using a method called SuperGrille, which is embedded in the groove of the front baffle to enhance the sense of unity with the enclosure and reduce the effect on sound quality.Not only does it protect the driver unit, but it is designed to listen when normally worn with a grill that smooths out the sound radiation.The exterior is a cheek finish."

name: HL-P3ES
description:
## Description

"Based on HL Compact7, this speaker system was developed with the theme of how to materialize Harvey House Sound in an easy-to-use small enclosure.The unit uses custom-made driver units with unique adjustment of materials with strict pair-matching standards.In addition, it is treated with anti-magnetic influence on TV screen etc. is prevented.In the low range, an 11cm cone type woofer with polypropylene diaphragm material is mounted.It uses a 25mm aluminum voice coil, is mounted on a diecast chassis, and uses new low-loss materials for surround for smoother piston motion.The high frequency band is equipped with a 1.9cm dome type tweeter using aluminum for the diaphragm, which has been adopted by Harvey since the HL Compact.As with the HL Compact, aluminum is treated with black anode to increase strength, and the voice coil is treated with ferrofluid cooling, which accelerates thermal diffusion at high temperatures by applying magnetic oil, so that the high frequency range can be reproduced stably.In addition, new synthetic resin material is used for the dome edge.The crossover network is designed to be optimal using computers and test equipment.In addition, the final sound is determined by the designer, Alan Shaw, who performs a balance tuning based on the reproducibility of the natural voice of close relatives including his beloved daughter ????.In addition, the network is installed close to the rear panel terminal.The speaker terminal is gold-plated with banana plug for bi-wiring connection.The enclosure is sealed using MDF material and has an internal volume of 5.6liters.Super Tuned Structure (STS), a tuning technology established in HL Compact7, is applied to the structure, and tuning is done with thin materials without making the wood thick and rigid unnecessarily. Referring to the manufacturing method of string instruments such as violins and acoustic techniques, by layering multiple materials with different resonance and stiffness between hard materials, unwanted resonance is damped by the physical properties of the materials themselves and their combination.The grill adopts the Frameless Frame method adopted in HL Compact7.The frame edge of the grille made of jersey material fits snugly into the groove of the front baffle to improve the integrity of the enclosure and improve sound reflection to improve directional characteristics and sound image localization."

description:
## Description

"A speaker system created by adding improvements to the HL-P3ES.11cm diameter polypropylene cone type woofer is used for the low range.It features a 2.5cm aluminum voice coil mounted on a die-cast chassis and low-loss material at the edges.A hard dome type tweeter with a 1.9cm diameter aluminum diaphragm is used for the high frequency band.By applying magnetic oil, it is subjected to ferrofluid cooling treatment which can maintain stable regeneration ability even at high temperature, and by using rigid resin for the edge, more accurate reproducibility is obtained.The network is designed using the same technology as LS3/5a. In addition, a unique method is used to refine the smoothness of listening by repeating trial listening with an emphasis on the reproducibility of human voices.By placing the low-frequency unit slightly behind the tweeter, the phase characteristics near the crossover point and on-axis power response are optimized.The speaker terminal is a banana plug type and can be connected by bi-wiring.The enclosure is designed by taking a lot of time to dump wood and tune response in particular, pursuing the ideal of a small speaker through analysis and trial and error. It is also designed based on SuperTunedStructure, which is the basis of enclosure design even in middle-size systems such as HL Compact 7ES-2.The baffle uses a round baffle to reduce sound wave diffraction at the edge, and also incorporates SuperGrille'Ωs method to optimize sound wave propagation by embedding a jersey grill in the front baffle.The exterior has a cherry finish."

name: LS5_12A
description:
## Description

"LS5/12A Grade1Miniature Monitor Loudspeaker developed by the BBC as a new reference for small speakers. Grade1means the highest grade monitor speaker used for sound check before sending from the studio to the transmitter. LS5/8, LS5/9, LS5/12A etc. were used.By the way, LS3/5A is a grade 2for checking speech program.A 11.5cm cone type woofer of 15W7508BBC (made by Dynaudio) is used for the low band.A 7.5cm large diameter aluminum voice coil is used to obtain stable reproducibility.A 2.8cm diameter dome type tweeter D-260BBC (manufactured by Dynaudio) is used for the high-frequency band.Ferrofluid cooling is used in this unit, and magnetic oil is applied to the voice coil to enhance its durability by promoting thermal diffusion when the voice coil becomes hot.In addition, excellent transients and low distortion are obtained by carefully molding and damping the rear chamber.The unit uses a sealed magnet to prevent magnetic flux leakage, and can be used as a TV monitor.The network section can be simplified by smoothing the characteristics of the unit, eliminating the complex characteristic correction network, using top-grade components such as air-core inductors, and using 5-ounce copper instead of the usual 1-ounce substrate.The enclosure has been designed based on CAD, with particular attention paid to the rear bass reflex port, which has an unusually large diameter relative to the enclosure size, and has optimized shape and structure to improve the bass response in order to obtain rich bass from a small volume.The front baffle has been rounded to prevent acoustic wave diffraction.It has a rosewood finish.The speaker terminal is bi-wired and has banana plug specifications.Each unit has smooth characteristics and allowable input, and meets the standard of tolerance of 0.25dB or less.The final balance of the system is optimized by intensive listening with experts from various fields gathered in the BBC studio and comparing the speaker output with the sound of live performance. The system is polished with an emphasis on reproducibility under actual operating conditions as well as theoretical measurements in an anechoic room."
